about_the_game:
Step into the enchanting world of anime-inspired stories, drawing on the style of classic Japanese fairy tales. This set takes inspiration from the distinctive aesthetics of Japanese anime films, leaving it entirely up to you to decide the story you want to create and the world you want to build.

What can you create?

With this set, you can design a picturesque anime town and its surrounding natural environment. Create scenes like a village laundry, a quaint rural settlement, a small junkyard, bustling markets, a vibrant main street, or the cozy interiors of a house and kitchen.
 And that’s just the beginning—there are endless creative possibilities waiting for you!

In the Tileset folder, you'll find A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C, D, E in four variations:

●     Normal

●     Color

●     Night

●     Sunset

--Contents--

●     Tilesets: 54 sheets

-----------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
